Installation
Prerequisites

pnpm 12 is a native executable and does not require Node.js after it is installed. Installing it through npm requires Node.js 22.13 or newer.
pnpm 12 is the current release line — the
latest
tag on npm points at it, so the commands below install pnpm 12 without naming a version.
Using pnpm

If you already have pnpm v11.10.0 or newer, update directly to pnpm 12:
pnpm
self-update
Inside a project that pins pnpm through the
packageManager
field,
self-update
only updates that pin instead of installing pnpm globally.
